name: Kagerou
source:
Kagura's attendant is pure and is still in training. He has a sharp tongue and does not dish words of flattery. 

From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/381100/The_Men_of_Yoshiwara_Kikuya/]Steam[/url]
